en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4223 - And Al-Ala' narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the Imams, peace be upon them, who said: "I asked him about the vessels of the People of the Book."
Imam (as) said: "Do not eat in their vessels if they eat in them the dead (carrion), blood, or the flesh of swine."
